## Title

**`melincom` --** retired; replaced by [metest](../metest/help.html)

## Description

`melincom` has been retired. Its replacement is [metest](../metest/help.html), which takes the same *ME #* references, so most calls translate directly:

`melincom 1 - 2` becomes `metest 1 - 2`

`melincom 1 - 2, add` becomes `metest 1 - 2, add`

`melincom clear` becomes `metest, clear`

`metest` additionally accepts coefficient names, multiplication and division, nonlinear functions, and equality tests, and it can be used after any estimation command rather than only after `mecompare`.

## Also see

[metest](../metest/help.html), [mecompare](help.html)
